item.title: Popular Baltimore vegan restaurant permanently closing
item.description: A popular vegan restaurant in Baltimore is closing its doors. Refocused Vegan announced it is permanently closing in a social media post.

item.title: Sunday: Cloudy with late day showers
item.description: Meteorologist Dylan Robichaud says we'll see a cloudy Sunday, with rain arriving later this evening. The heaviest rain will be in southern Maryland.
